name: Noncommunicable disease continuity of care
summary: An enormous burden area where the code-donation pathway is likely indirect: registries, reminders, longitudinal records, clinical workflow quality, and population reporting, especially in low- and middle-income settings.

metrics.claim: WHO's dashboard reports at least 43 million NCD deaths in 2021 and says 75% of non-pandemic-related deaths globally were from NCDs.
WHO's dashboard reports that 18 million people died from an NCD before age 70 in 2021, with most premature NCD deaths occurring in low- and middle-income countries.

software_pathways.claim: Likely OSS pathways include longitudinal patient registries, decision-support forms, appointment follow-up, reporting quality, and offline-first clinical tools; opportunity work must avoid private health data and preserve implementation humility.
